whenTarget.definition: A finalized independent canonical 2CQ teacher acquisition occurs in (tick, tick+horizon]. Teacher mint identity is not an input and need not be frozen-WHICH Top-1.
whenTarget.clusteredEvents: Each teacher acquisition remains an event; a FIRE can match at most one earliest eligible future event; no target, label, state, or window crosses a certified continuity gap.
whenTarget.gapHandling: Fail closed; gap time contributes zero ticks, labels, or valid development time.

tickAndRankCapture.teacherIndependentTickTrigger: Only non-teacher causal market events create ticks; teacher activity cannot create ticks.
tickAndRankCapture.candidateSnapshot: Every emitted autonomous tick stores a deterministic lossless ranked eligible universe, every candidate's frozen WHICH score, rank, margin to leader, persistence, create/event provenance, and causal feature vector.

architecture.stage1: WHEN detects a forthcoming teacher-like acquisition event.
architecture.stage2: After a WHEN fire, frozen WHICH ranking remains observationally available until a separately frozen causal handoff rule is selected using development only.

developmentStoppingRule.reason: Provides material temporal coverage beyond a short 24-hour probe while avoiding a new arbitrary performance gate.

validation: After development-only fitting and a separate immutable model/handoff freeze, collect a fresh untouched prospective validation cohort. No validation threshold is declared here.
